newsitem.title: CHINA: China to cut textile production capacity - report.
newsitem.headline: China to cut textile production capacity - report.

text.p: China will trim production capacity in the textile industry by barring inefficient producers, Wu Wenying, chief of the China National Textile Council, was quoted on Monday as saying.
China would tighten control of the production and purchasing of spinning frames to check future growth of the industry, the China Daily quoted Wu as saying.
Wu said existing permits would be re-examined and unqualified companies would not be allowed to continue production.
The newspaper gave no indication of what standard the industry regulators would maintain for determining whether a company was operating efficiently.
China's textile industry has been hurt by a host of problems, including overcapacity.
Industry officials said over the weekend that the existing export quota system needed to be reformed and that output of cotton and silk goods had to be reduced.
